parameters.name: DatasetIds
parameters.description: Dataset IDs. You can specify multiple dataset IDs separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to query. Default is 1. Page numbering starts from 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of entries per page. Default is 10.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: Object tags that the rule applies to. You can specify multiple tags.
